text:
Iris: Need a clean benchmark narrative for launch — hero visual + one-pager + 30s social. Focus: median latency vs $/1k, call out p95. Who owns what?

Marco: I can do the charts. Do we want end-to-end cost (infra+egress) or inference-only?

Iris: End-to-end. Add a tiny assumptions footer. Keep visuals mobile-first.

Tess: Ill write hero copy + 2 CTA variants (dev / enterprise). Draft hooks: dev="Ship fast, predict costs"; ent="SLA-ready serving, transparent unit economics". Which primary?

Iris: Make dev primary for social; enterprise variant for sales flows.

Ravi: Dropping a compact CSV baseline to plot. Rounded sims only.

Ravi: model,mode,median_ms,p95_ms,usd_per_1k; redwood-x-hosted,hosted,24,130,0.19; redwood-x-dedicated,dedicated,19,98,0.15; redwood-x-private,private,29,160,0.12; openmix-hosted,hosted,42,260,0.09

Marco: Perfect. Ill make two options: (A) scatter median vs $ with p95 size; (B) three tiles median / p95 / cost with one-line takeaways.

June: Ill handle GIF cut for socials (30s vertical). Need final PNGs + copy by 3pm PT.

Tess: Copy note: include a tiny footer calc: "Assumes 1k prompts @1k tokens. Prices include egress." Keep CTAs: Try Hosted API (utm=bench_dev) / Talk to Sales (utm=bench_ent).

Iris: Routing ask: can Growth create two nurture buckets bench_dev and bench_ent and map CTA toggle to them?

June: Yep — send me the utm values and Ill wire the GIF CTA to route.

Marco: ETA for first chart drafts: 2:30pm PT. Will include CSV + code snippet for reproducibility.

Tess: Copy drafts by 2pm PT. Short lines for the 30s cards.

Ravi: Ill add a short appendix CSV in the PDF with exact assumptions and test harness notes.

Iris: Checklist: Marco (charts) -> 2:30pm, Tess (copy) -> 2pm, June (GIF) -> 3pm, Ravi (CSV/appendix) -> final. If blockers ping me. :rocket:
